name: services/blobbox/get
description: Get the contents of a blob.
brief_description: Get the contents of a blob.

arguments.name: blob_id
arguments.description: Blob ID. You may only read blobs which you have access to (see the read_access parameter in the put_text method). Unaccessible blobs will appear as inexistent.

returns:
HTTP 200 response with raw contents of the blob.

If the blob does not exist (or you do not have access to it), we will respond with a HTTP 400 error.
